_help: Narration script for a-boy-is-about. Edit text/direction, then: python3 bucket-shared/tts.py reels/a-boy-is-about  (add --yes to make paid calls). 'beats' must match B in timeline.js (story seconds); 'at' is seconds into the beat (story time) where the line should start.

openai.style: A warm, cinematic storybook narrator. Natural and intimate, never announcer-like. Let the comedy land with small pauses.

lines.text: This is Milo. In about three seconds, a brick is going to land on his head.
lines.direction: Calm and cosy, a hint of mischief, as if sharing a secret.

lines.text: Where did it come from? Nobody knows. Clouds don't usually do that.
lines.direction: Genuinely puzzled, dry, a small pause before the last sentence.

lines.text: Anyone else would be in serious trouble. But Milo has a secret.
lines.direction: Slow and hushed, building suspense; lean in on 'secret'.
Matter-of-fact reveal, deadpan, a smile in the voice.

lines.text: Which makes the rest of his day... a little bouncy.
lines.direction: Amused, light, rhythm of a bounce on 'bouncy'.

lines.text: But he never drops the ice cream.
lines.direction: Proud and warm, like a punchline.
Bright, easy-going, a little laugh in it.
Warm, uplifting, cinematic closing line; let 'Bounce back' ring.
